fields.name: DialogInstanceId
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33053E0 (~esv::TimelineSystem::StopBehaviorTimelinePlacement(WorldView&, unsigned int, bool, unsigned int)) creates the component (bg3.exe+0x3311AE0) and stores its first unsigned int argument, the key of the system's placement maps (system +0x608 / +0x648); the same value goes into esv::timeline::PlacementStartRequestOneFrameComponent+0x70.

open_questions: That the unsigned int is the dialog instance id (as elsewhere in esv::TimelineSystem) and not a separate placement id is not proven; 48 live instances hold small ints 5..0x6A.
second_pass: Width and offset are from Windows (bg3.exe+0x33053E0 stores its first unsigned int argument); live values 5..0x6A agree.
raw_check: 48 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
